_doc: R024 tag-content adequacy (validate_plan.py): per workout tag, a whitelist of exercise names that count toward the tagged pillar and the minimum number of DISTINCT whitelist entries that must appear (case-insensitive substring) in the workout description. Empty default = rule off; each athlete defines their own pillars in the wrapper's config/exercise_tag_mapping.json. Example shape: {"tags": {"grip": {"min_exercises": 2, "exercises": ["Farmer Hold", "Dead Hang", "Pinch Grip"]}}}
